scenes.summary: You meet UWST crew mate Vallia and agree to open the gate of the Originium Byproduct Processing Center main building for him.

lines.text: Oh finally! Someone's here!
Yeah. Name's Vallia. I'm the Stock Redistributor at the Originium Byproduct Processing Center.
I was out delivering goods when the Landbreakers attacked. When I came back, the whole place was wrecked and the entrance was completely blocked.
Took me hours to clear that mess by the door. Just when I was to carry the supplies back in, I realized I couldn't even get the gate to budge.
Guess the Landbreakers wrecked the control system. They probably tried to force their way in and ended up breaking the entire thing... Bunch of idiots — even bad at being bad.

options: Are you cleaning up the place?

scenes.summary: Vallia and you notice that the main switch activated its safety and disconnected the entire building from the power grid. To re-activate the main switch, you must move the floating crates to the pressure switches.

lines.text: Just as I thought ... but it's better than what I expected.
The main switch activated its safety and disconnected. The entire building is off the grid.
I don't think so... The evac notice showed that everyone left in a big hurry.
The LBs are gone and support is on its way, so we gotta get the BPPC back in business. I need to figure out how to turn the main switch back on.
The crates are currently at the wrong positions. Move the floating crates to the pressure switches to re-activate the main switch.

options: Oh. I guess the crew were prepped for the evac.
Turn the main switch back on? How? Do we use these crates?
This actually looks interesting. Let me have a go.

scenes.summary: Power is being restored to the building. However, the production system power mains cannot be switched on. Vallia asks if you can go to the second floor and see what is wrong.

lines.text: Building power system is getting back online. It's a little slow but the system probably has to undergo post-reset self-diagnostics.
Hold on. Now this is weird...
All the sub-routines are working properly, but the production system power mains are still off the grid.
I need to stay here and monitor the self-diagnostics process. Can you head to 2F and check if anything broke down at that place?

scenes.summary: You meet Rammu who has been hiding at the second floor of the Originium BPPC building. To stop the production system, he chose to stay behind and switched off the mains. However, this also reset the entire system to its default settings. Rammu does not know how to reset the mains. You decide to help.

lines.text: I think someone moved this mechanism...
Hmm ... I'm afraid I don't really know.
UWST facilities are worlds apart from what we have at Endfield. If I must make a guess, I'd say the device looks like some type of switch.
Are the LBs gone?
Ugh. I dun wanna talk about it. Almost got myself killed...
Are you the support from Endfield? Thank goodness you've finally answered all the SOS messages I've spammed into the system... I'm Rammu. I work here.

It's the switch of the production system power mains. If nobody switches it off, the building's auto-production system will keep working and supplying those blighted LBs with a ton of Originium products...
Yeah. I switched it off. Shutting down the entire system takes a while. The others left first. When I was done, the LBs had completely surrounded this building.
That's why I hid myself to await rescue.
Oh ... that might be a little hard. The system resets to its default settings upon complete shut down. I'm ... uh ... not really familiar about restoring system operations...

options: Yeah. The breakers are gone. Why are you hiding here?
Know what's happening to this device?
So the power is now switched off?
The place is safe now. You can switch it back on.

scenes.summary: Vallia tells you that the production system power mains are back online. You tell him about Rammu and how he timely shut down the power. Vallia is extremely grateful and expresses his gratitude.

lines.text: You got the things to work! I got a notification telling me that the production system power mains are back online!
Another? Was this crew mate the one who shut down the power mains?
Is that so...? I thought he...
Ugh. Come to think of it, if the LBs really took control of this production system, we'll be in for super serious trouble.
Indeed. We gotta thank the dude ... and you as well, of course. The BPPC is finally back in business.
Here. Take this. A token of my gratitude.

options: Great. I also met another crew mate upstairs.
Yeah. He didn't want the LBs to use this place.
Yeah. He made the right call at a desperate moment.
